{{Quote|I love that Czerka gives back to the community and have really enjoyed participating in the many company-sponsored service projects.|Hawek Yellip|<ref name="Titans">{{TORweb|url=gameupdates/titans_of_industry|text=TITANS OF INDUSTRY}}</ref>}}
'''Hawek Yellip''' was an employee of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] who worked in the [[Czerka Sentient Resources Department]] as a [[Sentient Resources Specialist]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Yellip composed a promotional report on several prominent staff members at [[CZ-198]], Czerka's secure research and development facility: chief of security [[Zokar]], the advanced security droid [[CZ-8X Eradicator Droid|CZ-8X]], and the facility's foreman [[Gragov]].<ref name="Meet" />
